u_title: VM Analytics Collector - Registration and Phone-home Troubleshooting
u_summary: Check OVA power state, vCenter connection, authorization key, DNS, NTP, outbound HTTPS 443, collector service, registration status.

u_title: VM Analytics Collector - Missing Metrics After Deployment
u_summary: Validate vCenter credentials, collector registration, Pure1 telemetry timing, and recent network/proxy changes.
Check array latency, host latency, queue depth, capacity, snapshot load, workload spikes, and recent upgrades.

u_title: Capacity Forecast and Thin Provisioning Risk
u_summary: Review array utilization, data reduction, snapshots, growth rate, and 30/60/90 day forecast.
Check gateway health, cloud endpoint, cache size, egress, authentication, encryption, latency and regional network path.
Verify phone-home, edge management, upgrade agent, pre-checks, cluster state, active jobs, and failed upgrade step.

u_title: SafeMode and Unusual Data Activity Triage
u_summary: Check snapshot policy, SafeMode status, unusual activity signal, recent deletes, affected volumes, and escalation criteria.
Compare appliance version, alert signature, model, and customer environment with known issue database.
